description: This Java source file defines the class `InteropIdentifiersResponseData`, which extends `CommandProcessingResult`. It encapsulates a list of `InteropIdentifierData` objects, providing constructors and a static build method to create instances based on a `SavingsAccount`. The class appears to be part of the Fineract project for handling interoperation data related to identifiers.
